name: mktg-setup
description: First-run conversational setup wizard for marketing-cli. Use when /cmo detects no populated brand files and no cmo-preferences.md, when the user just installed marketing-cli for the first time, or when they say things like "set up marketing", "start marketing", "marketing wizard", "I just installed marketing-cli", "onboard me", "first time", "initial setup". Asks 3 sharp questions (identity, posture, distribution preferences), records the answers to brand/cmo-preferences.md, then hands off to /cmo's foundation flow which spawns 3 research agents in parallel. The user never has to type /mktg-setup directly — /cmo auto-routes here on first run.
